as_told.title: 4chan whistleblower says built-to-spec UFOs lie on the ocean floor

plain: UAPGerb, an online UFO researcher, mentions to podcast host Jesse Michels a claim from an anonymous whistleblower who posted on 4chan, an anonymous online message board. According to that post, a large mothership shaped like a hamburger, which 3D prints UFOs to order, is kept somewhere in the Bahamas. UAPGerb offers it only with the caveat 'if that whistleblower is to be believed'.
